creations.name: Write a blog post
creations.gives: A topic, and optionally a brief, a tone and who it is for.
creations.returns: A Markdown draft with a title, a standfirst and cited sources, saved as a draft you can edit.

creations.name: Draw an icon
creations.gives: A name for the icon and what it stands for.
creations.returns: Up to four line drawings in OpenVibe's hand, each with its solid twin, checked before you see them.
